author: PureMagic
body:
I've been banned for Ban Evasion by GrapeSmoothie. I understand why he banned me because my brother made a appeal and got denied and I joined the server when he made the appeal. I do have something to prove that I am right, If you go to his Profile (CryptioxPlayz) You can see I've played with him because he killed me. I hope i didn't miss things and that you can understand my problem. If not, I'll have to accept :( .


Trisno7 is my Minecraft name at the moment, I wont change it till the problem is solved.
